basis: Mitochondrial encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis; sensorineural hearing loss affects roughly 40-60%; cardiomyopathy is less consistently common.
Severe intellectual disability, absent speech and seizures define the disorder; episodic central breathing abnormalities do not establish pulmonary damage.
Defined by obstruction of the conducting airways.
Thymic epithelial tumour; thymus has no listed anatomical axis. This is not lymphoma; associated myasthenia or red cell aplasia are separate diseases.
Progressive muscular dystrophy with contractures; mild cardiomyopathy and ventricular ectopy reported, cardiac findings in ~50%; respiratory restriction reflects muscle weakness.
Usher type I combines congenital sensorineural deafness, vestibular dysfunction and progressive rod-cone retinal dystrophy.
Defining combination of blepharochalasis, duplicated oral lip mucosa and thyroid enlargement; thyroid abnormalities are frequent in supplied HPO annotations.
Germ cell carcinoma predominantly arising in reproductive organs; CNS origin is a minority subtype and does not define the umbrella.
Ehrlichia infect leukocytes and commonly cause cytopenias; direct hepatic inflammation with aminotransferase elevation occurs in roughly 70-90%.
Melanoma most often originates in skin; epithelioid describes cell morphology. Uveal disease is a site-specific subtype, not universal ocular involvement.
Congenital anomalous origin of a pulmonary artery; associated septal, aortic and ductal defects are also cardiovascular.
Defective antigen-driven lymphocyte proliferation causes combined immunodeficiency; recurrent respiratory infections are separate infections, not established intrinsic lung damage.
Fraser malformations include cryptophthalmos, urinary tract agenesis and syndactyly, each reported in ~75%; individual airway and intestinal defects occur in 25%.
Postinfectious systemic inflammation with myocardial injury and shock; gastrointestinal inflammation affects roughly 70-90% and is a major diagnostic organ category.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder causing characteristic ECG changes and ventricular arrhythmias.
Benign ovarian epithelial tumour; reproductive tissue origin does not imply endocrine gland dysfunction.
Progressive skeletal muscular dystrophy with limb-girdle weakness and contractures; no evidence of another commonly damaged organ.
Hepatic glycogen synthesis defect causes fasting ketotic hypoglycemia; neurologic complications and elevated transaminases are occasional.
Destructive resorption of tooth-root cementum or dentin; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Hearing loss, neurologic abnormalities and dental defects define syndrome; ptosis in 2/2 supports ocular involvement. Muscle weakness lacks proof of intrinsic myopathy.
Congenital extra postaxial digits with possible metacarpal fusion; occasional cutaneous syndactyly does not establish separate skin disease.
Inherited retinal dysfunction or degeneration caused by biallelic ATF6 variants; neurologic ancestry does not establish extraocular disease.
Congenital bilateral fusion of the radius and ulna.
ID/DD define disease; ocular dysfunction and dental defects frequent (30-79%); ASD 7/10 and PDA frequent support cardiac involvement. Frequent minor limb anomalies omitted by cap.
Midfacial skeletal developmental abnormality classified as an osteochondrodysplasia.
